DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 包装担当の方ですね。入室前の準備で、気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are on packaging duties, correct? Is there anything concerning you about preparations before entering?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 作業着の袖口が破れています。自分でテープを貼らず、交換について聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袖口の破れを報告し、自分でテープ補修せず交換について相談に来たと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The cuff of my work clothes is torn. I came to ask about a replacement rather than patch it with tape myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the torn cuff in Japanese and say that you came to ask about replacement rather than repair it yourself with tape.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま入室せず、更衣担当に交換を相談しましょう。今日の担当表は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not enter wearing it; let us consult the changing-room staff about a replacement. Have you checked today's duty roster?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 担当表では袋詰め後の表示確認です。ただ、手元のラベルと作業票で商品名が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当が袋詰め後の表示確認だと答え、ラベルと作業票の商品名の違いを報告する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The roster says checking labels after bagging. However, the product names on the label I have and the work sheet differ.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that your duty is checking labels after bagging, and report the different product names on the label and work sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 貼る前に気付いたのですね。何が書かれているか、両方を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You noticed before attaching it, then. Please tell me what each says separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ラベルは「切り身」で、作業票は「詰め合わせ」です。まだ一枚も貼っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ラベルの切り身と作業票の詰め合わせを読み分け、まだ貼っていないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The label says “Fish fillets,” and the work sheet says “Assortment.” I have not attached a single label yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the label's “Fish fillets” and work sheet's “Assortment” separately in Japanese and say that you have not attached any.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの記載を責任者へ伝えます。古いラベルかどうかも、ここでは決められません。作業票の版は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will tell the person in charge about both entries. We cannot determine here whether the label is old either. Can you read the work sheet's version?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 版の欄は読めますが、最新版かは確認できていません。商品名だけ書き換えて使うのはやめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 版の記載は読めるが最新版か未確認と述べ、商品名を書き換えて使わないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read the version field, but I have not confirmed whether it is the latest. I will not simply rewrite the product name and use it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the version is readable but unconfirmed as current, and that you will not rewrite the product name and use it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。私からラベルの件を連絡します。作業着の交換と、包装担当からの説明のどちらを先に待つか決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Correct. I will contact them about the label. Let us decide whether to first wait for replacement work clothes or an explanation from the packaging staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に更衣担当へ行きます。着替えの確認後も、ラベルの返事が来るまでは表示確認の作業を始めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先に更衣担当へ行き、交換後もラベルの返事が来るまで作業を始めないと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will go to the changing-room staff first. Even after the clothing check, I will not start the labeling checks until a reply about the labels arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to go to the changing-room staff first and not start work after changing until the label reply arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 戻ったら包装担当と説明を合わせましょう。商品名と版の確認を引き継いでおきます。いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: When you return, let us coordinate the explanation with the packaging staff. I will pass on the product-name and version checks. See you when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 布団のご利用でしょうか。表示が付いているところを一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to wash bedding? Let us look together at the parts with care labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カバーの表示はありますが、中の布団の札は文字が消えています。一緒に洗えると思って持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カバーに表示があり布団本体の札は消えていると説明し、一緒に洗うつもりだったと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The cover has a label, but the writing on the quilt itself has faded away. I brought them thinking I could wash them together.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the cover is labeled but the quilt's label has faded, and say that you planned to wash them together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カバーの表示を本体の条件としては使えません。中の布団の説明書や、購入時の資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The cover's label cannot be used as the quilt's care conditions. Do you have instructions for the quilt or documents from when you bought it?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 資料は家にあります。本体は今日は入れず、先にその資料を探すことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 購入時の資料が家にあると答え、今日は本体を入れず資料を探すと決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The documents are at home. I will not put the quilt in today and will look for them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the purchase documents are at home and decide not to put the quilt in today, but to look for the documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では本体はお持ち帰りください。カバーだけの利用もお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please take the quilt home. Are you also considering washing only the cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: カバーだけ洗いたいです。この表示については読めるので、機械の対象と照合してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カバーだけの洗濯を希望し、読める表示と機械の対象の照合を依頼する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to wash just the cover. I can read its label, so could you compare it with the items the machine accepts?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request washing only the cover in Japanese and ask for its readable label to be compared with the machine's permitted items.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 当店の案内にはこの種類のカバーが対象としてありますが、乾燥についての表示も別に見ましょう。こちらの記号は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Our guidance includes this type of cover, but let us look at the drying instructions separately too. Can you read this symbol?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乾燥の記号はよく分かりません。洗う条件だけで乾燥もできるとは決めず、今日は乾燥を選ばないでおきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 乾燥記号が分からないと伝え、洗濯可否と混同せず今日は乾燥を選ばないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not really understand the drying symbol. I will not assume washing permission also means drying is possible, and I would prefer not to select drying today.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you do not understand the drying symbol and will not confuse it with washing permission, so will not select drying today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その選び方なら、洗濯後の持ち帰り方法も考えておきましょう。ぬれたカバーを入れる袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you choose that, let us also plan how to take it home after washing. Do you have a bag for a wet cover?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 防水の袋を持っています。カバーだけの洗濯案内を確認し、本体とは別に持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 防水の袋があると答え、洗濯案内を確認してカバーを本体と別に持ち帰ると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a waterproof bag. I will confirm the instructions for washing only the cover and take it home separately from the quilt.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a waterproof bag and will check the washing guidance and take the cover home separately from the quilt.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、カバー用の機械の表示をご案内します。本体の資料が見つかったら、またご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you the machine guidance for covers. Please consult us again when you find the quilt's documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 行先のメモをお持ちですね。片道のご利用ですか、お帰りも一緒にご相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a destination note, correct? Is this a one-way trip, or would you also like advice about returning?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「交流館前」まで行きます。帰る時間を決めていないので、往復を今買う必要があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交流館前へ行くと伝え、帰りが未定の場合に往復を今買う必要があるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going to “Koryukan-mae,” in front of the community exchange center. I do not know my return time, so I want to know whether I need to buy a return ticket now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the destination Koryukan-mae and ask in Japanese whether you must buy a return ticket now if your return time is undecided.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この窓口では片道だけのお申込みもできます。交流館という名前の施設が二つありますが、メモの停留所名はこちらで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can apply for just one way at this counter too. There are two facilities called an exchange center; is the stop on your note this one?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 交流館前という停留所です。「交流館入口」のほうではありません。こちらの地図の印と合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 交流館前と交流館入口を区別し、地図の印との照合を求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is the stop “Koryukan-mae,” not “Koryukan-iriguchi,” the exchange-center entrance. Please compare it with this mark on the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish Koryukan-mae from Koryukan-iriguchi in Japanese and ask for comparison with the map mark.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地図の印と交流館前を照合できました。乗車人数と、ご希望の支払方法を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have matched the map mark and Koryukan-mae. Please tell me how many passengers and how you would like to pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人分です。現金を使いたいのですが、ここで買う場合と車内で払う場合は分けて考えればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人分で現金払いを希望し、窓口購入と車内支払いを分けて考えるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: One person. I want to use cash; should I distinguish buying here from paying aboard?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want one person's fare paid in cash and ask whether counter purchase and onboard payment should be considered separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。今は窓口で申し込む券についてご案内します。現金でお受けできますので、発券前に行先と金額をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. For now, we are explaining tickets applied for at the counter. We can accept cash, so please check the destination and price before issuing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 金額は確認しました。券に乗車する日も入るのでしょうか。今日は下見だけで、乗るのは明日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額確認を伝え、今日は下見で実際に乗るのは明日だと訂正して券の日付を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have checked the amount. Will the date of travel also appear on the ticket? I am only checking things out today and will travel tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you checked the amount, clarify that today is only a preliminary visit and travel is tomorrow, and ask about the ticket date.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 明日のご利用ですね。では、今日の日付で出さず、明日の片道一人分として申込み内容を読み上げます。よろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: For tomorrow, then. Instead of issuing it for today, I will read back the application as one person, one way, tomorrow. Is that all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明日、交流館前までの片道一人分でお願いします。帰りの券は予定が決まってから相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 明日の交流館前まで片道一人分を依頼し、帰りの券は後で相談すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please make it one person, one way to Koryukan-mae tomorrow. I will discuss the return ticket after my plans are decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese one person one way to Koryukan-mae tomorrow and say you will discuss the return later.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で承ります。発券した券の日付と行先をもう一度お確かめください。明日はお気を付けてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will accept it on those terms. Please check the issued ticket's date and destination once more. Have a safe trip tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗り場までの移動でお困りですか。案内図ならこちらでご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble getting to the boarding area? You can look at a map here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行かばんが重くて、段差の多い道は避けたいです。乗車券にある乗り場まで、平らな通路を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 重い旅行かばんがあり、券の乗り場へ段差の少ない通路で行きたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: My suitcase is heavy, and I want to avoid a route with many steps. I am looking for a level passage to the boarding area on my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a heavy suitcase and want a route with fewer steps to the boarding area on your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 乗車券の乗り場は確認できました。案内図では、屋内を通る経路と外側の経路があります。雨にぬれないほうをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have identified the boarding area on the ticket. The map shows an indoor route and an outside route. Do you prefer to avoid getting wet in the rain?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 屋内を通りたいです。ただ、途中で座れる場所がないと、一度に運ぶのは難しそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 屋内経路を希望し、途中に座る場所が必要な理由を説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like the indoor route. However, carrying it all at once seems difficult unless there is somewhere to sit along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request the indoor route and explain in Japanese why you need somewhere to sit partway.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 屋内通路の途中にベンチが載っています。荷物を置いて通路を狭めない位置で休めるか、一緒に図を見ましょう。出発まではどのくらいありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The map shows a bench partway along the indoor passage. Let us look together for somewhere to rest without narrowing the passage with your luggage. How long until departure?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 乗車券の時刻までは二十分あります。休む時間を入れて、乗り場で慌てないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出発まで二十分あると答え、休憩を含めて慌てずに移動したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are twenty minutes until the time on my ticket. I want to include rest time and avoid rushing at the boarding area.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that departure is in twenty minutes and you want to move without rushing, including a rest.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、出発の案内も見ながら進みましょう。荷物を車両へ載せるときの手助けも必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us proceed while also checking departure guidance. Do you need help loading the luggage onto the vehicle too?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 車両の段差が分からないので、持ち上げる必要があるか乗務員に聞きたいです。手伝ってもらえるとはまだ考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車両の段差と荷物を持ち上げる必要を乗務員に聞きたいと述べ、援助は未確認と伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not know what the vehicle's steps are like, so I want to ask the crew whether I need to lift it. I have not assumed assistance is available yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to ask the crew about steps and lifting the luggage, and that assistance is not yet confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 対応の可否は乗務員へ確認します。私はこの窓口で連絡しますが、客室の座席を変えるご希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check with the crew whether assistance is possible. I will contact them from this counter; would you also like to change your passenger seat?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 座席は変えなくて大丈夫です。荷物の積み方の確認だけお願いします。返事があるまでは、この待合の端で待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座席変更は不要と答え、荷物の積み方だけの確認を依頼して待機場所を述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: The seat can stay as it is. Please check only how to load the luggage. Until there is a reply, I will wait at the edge of this waiting area.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that no seat change is needed, request only a luggage-loading check, and state where you will wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 積込みについて確認してからお呼びします。通路は空けたまま、こちらでお待ちください。いったん失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will call you after checking the loading arrangements. Keep the passage clear and wait here, please. Excuse me for the moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱を再利用されるのですね。新しい送り状を記入する前に、中身と送り先を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reusing a box, correct? Before you write a new shipping label, may I ask about its contents and destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内の家族に、シャツと陶器のカップを送ります。前に使った宛名が、まだ横に付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 国内の家族宛てのシャツと陶器カップだと答え、箱に古い宛名が残ると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am sending a shirt and ceramic cup to family within Japan. The old address from its previous use is still attached to the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State in Japanese that the contents are a shirt and ceramic cup for family within Japan, and that an old address remains on the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい送り先と紛らわしくならないよう、古い表示を確認しましょう。中のカップは、箱の中で動かないように包装されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the old markings so they will not be confused with the new destination. Is the cup packed so that it cannot move inside the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カップは包みましたが、箱の中で少し動きます。閉じる前に包装を見直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: カップは包んだが箱内で動くと説明し、封をする前に包装を見直したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrapped the cup, but it still moves a little inside the box. I would like to reconsider the packing before closing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the wrapped cup still moves and you want to review the packing before sealing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中身に合う包装についてご案内します。包装しても破損がないというお約束はできません。送り先のご住所は確定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will explain packaging suited to the contents. Even with packaging, we cannot promise there will be no damage. Is the recipient's address confirmed?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自宅宛てに書くつもりでしたが、家族が日中留守です。勤務先で受け取れるか、先に本人へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自宅では日中留守だと述べ、勤務先受取りができるか本人に先に確認したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I intended to write the home address, but my family is out during the day. I want to first ask them whether they can receive it at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the family is out during the day and you want to first confirm with them whether workplace receipt is possible.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 勤務先宛てにするなら、受取先で受領できるかも確かめてください。今日は受付せず、確認後にお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you send it to the workplace, please also confirm that the receiving location can accept it. Will you take it home today without submitting it and bring it after checking?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: そうします。今日は持ち帰って、古い宛名の処理と包装をやり直します。新しい送り状は、住所が決まってから書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は持ち帰ると答え、古い宛名と包装を整え、新しい送り状は住所確定後に書きたいと尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will take it home today, deal with the old address, and repack it. May I write the new shipping label after the address is decided?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take it home, correct the old address and packing, and ask to write the new label after the address is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。未確定の住所は今書かず、確認できた内容を記入しましょう。お戻りの際に、配達の見込みについてもお調べしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Do not write an unconfirmed address now; enter the details once confirmed. When you return, would you also like us to check the estimated delivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見込みは聞きたいですが、日付を確約されたとは考えません。家族には受取先の確認だけ、まず連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配達見込みは聞きたいが確約とは思わないと伝え、まず家族に受取先を確認すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like an estimate, but I will not consider the date guaranteed. First I will contact my family just to check the receiving location.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want an estimate but do not regard it as a guarantee, and decide to confirm the receiving location with family first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、今日は発送を保留にします。送り先と包装が整ったら、改めて拝見します。お気を付けてお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-AMAKUSA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will hold the shipment today. Once the address and packing are ready, we will look at it again. Take care carrying it home.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業表を見ながら説明します。ご自分の名前の欄は見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will explain using the work roster. Have you found the field with your name?

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 牛を移す担当だと思っていましたが、初日なので近づく位置が分かりません。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 牛を動かす担当と思っているが、初日で接近する位置が分からないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I was assigned to move the cattle, but it is my first day and I do not know where to approach them.
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you thought you were assigned to move cattle but do not know where to approach on your first day.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その欄は隣の方のお名前ですね。あなたの欄には「記録の整理」とあります。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-03.translation: That field has the next person's name. Your field says “Organizing records.”

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 行を一つ読み違えました。今日は牛を動かすのではなく、記録を整理する担当ですね。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 作業表の行を読み違え、今日は牛の移動ではなく記録整理の担当だと確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-04.translation: I misread the row by one line. Today I am responsible for organizing records, not moving cattle, correct?
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you misread a row and today's duty is records, not moving cattle.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのとおりです。牛舎を見学する前にも、現地の担当者から説明を受けましょう。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct. Before touring the cattle shed too, let us hear the explanation from the staff there.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見学中に立つ場所も、その担当者に実際の場所で示してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見学時の立ち位置を現地の担当者に実際の場所で示してほしいと求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would also like those staff to show me, at the actual site, where to stand during the tour.
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the on-site staff to show you the actual standing position during the tour.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ここで立ち位置を決めず、その希望を引き継ぎます。作業表の連絡先は読めますか。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will not decide that position here; I will pass on your request. Can you read the contact person on the roster?

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡先の名前は読めます。普段と違う牛の様子に気づいたら、何を伝えるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先の名前は読めると伝え、普段と違う牛を見た場合の報告内容を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can read the contact's name. What should I report if I notice a cow behaving differently from usual?
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you can read the contact name and ask what to report if you notice an unusual cow.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どの牛がどこにいて、何を見たかを伝えます。病気だと決めつけず、判断は現地の担当者へつなげてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-09.translation: Report which cow is where and what you saw. Do not decide it is ill; leave the judgment to the on-site staff.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 牛の識別と見た様子を分けて報告します。まず自分の担当欄を確かめてから、見学の説明を受けます。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 牛の識別と観察を分けて報告し、担当欄確認後に見学説明を受けると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report the cow's identity and what I saw separately. First I will check my own duty field and then hear the tour explanation.
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will report identification separately from observation and receive the tour explanation after checking your duty field.

DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、あなたの作業表と見学時の希望を現地の担当へ渡します。この時間の説明は以上です。見学先でもどうぞよろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-KUM-ASO-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will give your work roster and tour request to the on-site staff. That concludes this explanation. Please work with the staff at the tour site as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 山歩きのご相談でしょうか。お持ちの案内はいつご覧になったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about walking in the mountains? When did you look at the guidance you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前に来た友人から、この案内板の写真をもらいました。短い道なら私にも歩けるかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人から受け取った案内写真を示し、短い道を歩きたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: A friend who visited before gave me this photograph of an information board. I thought I might manage a short route.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the guidance photograph from your friend and say in Japanese that you want to walk a short route.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真には撮影日がありませんね。今の通行情報と同じとは限りません。山歩きの経験はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The photograph has no date, does it? It may not match the current access information. Do you have mountain-walking experience?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 山道はほとんど初めてです。今日は街を歩く靴しか持ってきていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 山道の経験がほぼなく、街歩き用の靴しか持参していないと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am almost completely new to mountain paths. Today I have only brought shoes for walking in town.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have almost no mountain-path experience and only brought town-walking shoes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 写真の短い経路という説明だけでは、その装備で利用できるとは判断できません。どなたかとご一緒ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The photograph's description of a short route alone does not tell us whether it is suitable with that equipment. Are you with someone?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人と二人ですが、友人も道を知りません。戻る時刻もまだ相談していませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行する友人も道を知らず、帰る時刻も未相談だと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two of us, my friend and me, but my friend does not know the route either. We had not discussed a return time yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your accompanying friend also does not know the route and you have not discussed a return time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 経路の情報、装備、戻る計画をそろえて考える必要があります。今日は予定をどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You need to consider the route information, equipment, and return plan together. What will you do about today's plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 山道へ入るのは見送ります。次に来る前に、どこで新しい情報を確かめるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日の山歩きを見送り、次回前に新しい情報を確認する先を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will not go onto the mountain path today. Please tell me where to check updated information before my next visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese not to walk in the mountains today and ask where to check new information before next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの新しい案内には、情報の問い合わせ先と更新日が載っています。対象の経路が合っているかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This updated guidance lists the information contact and update date. Please also check that the route concerned is the one you intend.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 問い合わせ先を控えて、友人にも中止を伝えます。今日は案内室で次回の準備を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問い合わせ先を控え友人に中止を伝え、今日は案内室で準備を相談すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note the contact and tell my friend we are canceling. Today I would like to discuss preparations for next time in the information room.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide in Japanese to note the contact, tell your friend about cancellation, and discuss preparations in the information room today.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内室で、お考えの経路と準備したいことをお話しください。それでは、今日は無理をせずお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please tell the information-room staff the route you are considering and what you want to prepare. Do not push yourself today, and enjoy the rest of your day.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの水筒を比べていらっしゃいますね。主にどこでお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are comparing these drink bottles, correct? Where will you mainly use one?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の昼休みに使います。毎日洗うので、この二つのうち手入れしやすい方を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昼休みに毎日使うため、二つの水筒の手入れしやすさを比べたいと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: At my lunch break at work. I will wash it every day, so I am looking for the easier one to care for out of these two.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to compare care of two bottles for everyday lunch-break use.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは口が広く、もう一方は細い形です。蓋の部品についても説明書を見ましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This one has a wide opening, and the other is narrow. Shall we also look at the instructions for the lid components?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 蓋も洗いたいです。外せる部品と、なくさずに戻せるかを実物で見比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗うために外せる蓋部品と戻しやすさを実物で比べたいと求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to wash the lid too. I would like to compare the actual removable parts and whether I can reassemble them without losing any.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to compare removable lid parts and ease of putting them back for washing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この見本で部品をご覧いただけます。持ち運ぶかばんの大きさはお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see the parts on this sample. Do you know the size of the bag you will carry it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: このかばんに立てて入れたいのですが、口の広い方は高さが合うでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参かばんに立てて入れたいので、口の広い方の高さが合うか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to put it upright in this bag; will the wide-opening one's height fit?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the wide-opening bottle's height fits upright in the bag you brought.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: かばんの口に余裕があるか見てみましょう。細い方は入りますが、広い方は蓋が上に出ますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us see whether there is room at the bag opening. The narrow one fits, but the wide one has its lid sticking out above it.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通勤中はかばんを閉めたいので、細い方を候補にします。洗い方の説明は付いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: かばんを閉めるため細い方を候補にし、洗い方の説明書の有無を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want to close the bag on my commute, so I will consider the narrow one. Does it come with cleaning instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will consider the narrow bottle so your bag closes, and ask whether cleaning instructions are included.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の中に説明書があります。お選びの品と表示の価格はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: There is an instruction sheet inside the box. Here are your selected item and its displayed price.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 値段も予算内です。説明書を見ながら手入れできて、かばんも閉まる、この細い水筒をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予算内で手入れ方法とかばんの収まりに合う、細い水筒を購入すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The price is within my budget too. Please give me this narrow bottle, which I can care for using the instructions and fit in my closed bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese the narrow bottle that fits your budget, care needs, and bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 細い方をお包みします。説明書も箱に入っていますので、お持ち帰りください。またのご来店をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will wrap the narrow one. The instructions are also inside the box, so please take them home. We look forward to your next visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お書きになった振込用紙を、ご自身で確かめたいとのことですね。どの欄が気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to check the transfer form you filled in yourself, correct? Which field concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受取人の欄に自分の名前を書きましたが、家賃を受け取る管理会社の名前を書く所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取人欄に自分の名前を書いたが、家賃を受け取る管理会社名の欄か尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my own name in the recipient field, but is it meant for the management company that receives the rent?
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you wrote your own name in the recipient field and ask whether it should be the rent-receiving management company.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。受け取る相手と、振り込むご本人の欄は別です。管理会社からの振込先案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. The recipient's field and your own field as the sender are separate. Do you have the management company's transfer instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内があります。銀行名、支店名、口座の種類と番号も、案内と一つずつ照らし合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 振込先案内を示し、銀行名・支店名・口座種別・番号を個別に照合すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here are the instructions. I will compare the bank name, branch name, account type, and number with them one by one too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the transfer instructions and say in Japanese that you will compare the bank, branch, account type, and number separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書き直した受取人名もご覧ください。振込人の名前について、提出先から指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also check the rewritten recipient name. Has the recipient organization specified anything for the sender's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 管理会社からは部屋番号を添えるよう言われました。自分の氏名だけでよいと勘違いしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 振込人名に部屋番号を添える指定があり、氏名だけでよいと誤解したと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The management company asked me to add the room number. I had misunderstood and thought just my full name was enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the sender name must include the room number and you misunderstood that your name alone was enough.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご指定の表記を、この案内に沿って確かめましょう。金額の欄についてもご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the required wording against these instructions. Do you also have questions about the amount field?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家賃の振込額と手数料は別ですね。相手へ送る金額から手数料を引かずに確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送る家賃と手数料を別にし、振込額から手数料を差し引かずに確認したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The rent to transfer and the fee are separate, correct? I want to check without deducting the fee from the amount sent to the recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to check the rent and fee separately without subtracting the fee from the transfer amount.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 送る金額と、ご利用方法に応じた手数料を別にご説明します。実行前に合計もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the amount to send separately from the fee for the method you use. Please also check the total before execution.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取人名は管理会社の案内どおりに直しました。振込人の表記と送る金額、手数料を確認して、この内容で申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取人名を直し、振込人表記・送金額・手数料を確認した内容で申込みをする。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I corrected the recipient name according to the management company's instructions. I have checked the sender wording, amount to send, and fee, and will apply with these details.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you corrected the recipient name and will apply with the confirmed sender wording, transfer amount, and fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、このお申込み内容を受け付けます。控えを受け取るまでお待ちください。ご相談は以上です。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will accept these application details. Please wait until you receive your receipt. That concludes the consultation. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時刻表の、どちらの列車についてお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which train on the timetable are you asking about?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先に出るこちらの列車で、待ち合わせの駅まで行きたいです。この印が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 早く出る列車を候補にし、時刻表の印の意味が分からないと尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to take this earlier-departing train to the station where I am meeting someone. I cannot read this symbol.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Identify the earlier train as your option and ask in Japanese about the timetable symbol you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その印は、この欄の駅を通過することを表しています。降りたい駅の欄はこちらで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: That symbol means the train passes through the station in this row without stopping. Is this the row for the station where you want to get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅で合っています。数字がないので、到着時刻を省いているだけかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 目的駅の欄は合っているが、数字がないのは時刻の省略だと思ったと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, that is the station. Because there was no number, I thought they had simply omitted the arrival time.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is the correct station row but you thought the absence of numbers only meant an omitted time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この列車はその駅に停まりません。停車する列車の欄を一緒に見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This train does not stop at that station. Let us look together at the columns for trains that do stop.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 各駅停車なら乗換えずに行ける案はありますか。慣れないので、乗り降りする回数を増やしたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不慣れなので乗換えを増やさず、各駅停車で行ける案を相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is there an option using a local train without a transfer? I am unfamiliar with it and do not want to increase the number of times I get on and off.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a local train without extra transfers because you are unfamiliar with the route.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの各駅停車は、ご希望の駅まで乗換えのない案として表示されています。ご都合に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: This local train is shown as an option without a transfer to your desired station. Does that suit your plans?

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その案にします。友人を待たせないよう、到着の見込みを先に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提示された乗換えのない案を選び、友人へ到着見込みを伝えると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will choose that option. I will tell my friend my estimated arrival first so they are not kept waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the proposed no-transfer option and say in Japanese that you will tell your friend your estimated arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出発案内でも行き先と停車駅を見てください。列車の名前だけでお乗り間違いにならないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the destination and stops on the departure guidance too. Do not board the wrong train based only on its name.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に出る列車ではなく、目的の駅に停まる方を待ちます。案内の停車駅にも、この駅名があるか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 早い列車でなく目的駅に停まる方を待ち、停車駅表示も確認すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the train that stops at my destination, not the one leaving first. I will also check that the station name appears in the stop information.
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for the stopping train rather than the earlier one and also check the displayed stops.

DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望の経路が決まりましたね。それでは、表示に変更がないかご覧になって、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KUM-ASO-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: You have decided your route now. Please watch for any changes to the displays, and have a good trip.
